facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition's national data governance strategy SNGD 2030 sets as a principle that all data classified as critical information infrastructure must be processed and stored inside Côte d'Ivoire, by staff at least 20% Ivorian, with a copy kept in the country for law enforcement; the document gives no date of its own, so its published date of 2024-01-01 is used.

systems.tiers: government and state entities (non-critical classified data)

note: The strategy also says non-critical government data must be stored in the national data center or national cloud; no enforcer or application of the rule is stated.
